prompt: Make an animated heart icon that pulses once per second.
Make a notification bell icon that rings and settles, looping.
Make a success checkmark that draws itself inside a circle, then holds.
Make a hamburger menu icon that morphs into a close X and back.
Make a download icon: an arrow that moves down into a tray, looping.
Make a padlock icon whose shackle opens and closes.
Make a loading spinner with a rotating arc. Transparent background.
Make a three-dot typing indicator where the dots bounce in sequence.
Make a horizontal progress bar that fills from 0 to 100 percent and loops.
Make a loader with three small circles orbiting a centre point at different speeds.
Make an audio equaliser loader with five bars that rise and fall out of step.
Make a ripple loader: two rings expanding from the centre and fading out.
Make a toggle switch that slides from off to on with a colour change.
Make a call-to-action button that has a subtle idle shine sweeping across it.
Make a like button: a heart that pops with small particles bursting outward.
Make a toast notification that slides in from the top, holds, and slides out.
Make a tab bar with three labels as shapes and an underline that slides between them.
Make a full-screen colour wipe transition with three bands sweeping across in sequence.
Make an iris transition: a circle that grows to cover the frame, then shrinks to reveal.
Make a logo reveal: a simple geometric mark that scales in with overshoot, then a line draws under it.
Make a bouncing ball with squash and stretch and a ground shadow.
Make a friendly blob character with two eyes that blinks and waves one arm.
Make a small robot standing still with an idle bob, a blink and an antenna that wiggles.
Make a simple sitting cat silhouette with a swaying tail and blinking eyes.
Make a landscape where a sun rises behind two hills and the sky shifts from night to dawn colours.
Make a rocket lifting off with flame, smoke puffs and twinkling stars in the background.
Make a cloud with rain falling from it and small ripples on the ground.
Make a pulsing circle badge in the colours #0F172A, #38BDF8 and #F8FAFC, 512 by 512, loops every 2 seconds.

Animate it so the circle pops in and the tick draws on.
Make a 1080 by 1080, 60 fps, 1.5 second looping animation of a gear rotating, in grey tones.
